metadata.title: Review a job | Slashie
metadata.description: Leave a star rating and an optional comment for a completed Slashie job.

en.starsDescription: Choose 1 to 5 stars. You can edit this for 48 hours after you submit.
en.commentDescription: Optional. Say what the other person should know about this job.
en.submitDescription: Reviews are opinions between the customer and the worker. Slashie does not check or endorse anyone through a review.
en.commentTooLong: Comment must be {max} characters or fewer.
en.lockedBody: Reviews can be edited for 48 hours after they are submitted.
en.signInBody: Sign in as the customer or worker on this completed job to leave a review.
en.ineligibleTitle: This job is not ready for a review
en.ineligibleBody: A review opens after the order is completed, for the customer and the booked worker.
en.unavailable: Reviews are not available right now. Try again shortly.

metadata.title: 評價工作 | Slashie
metadata.description: 為已完成的 Slashie 工作留下星級和可選留言。

zh_hk.starsDescription: 選擇 1 至 5 星。提交後 48 小時內可以修改。
zh_hk.commentDescription: 可選。告訴對方關於這份工作你想他們知道的事。
zh_hk.submitDescription: 評價是顧客與工作者之間的意見。Slashie 不會透過評價審查或認可任何人。
zh_hk.commentTooLong: 留言不可超過 {max} 個字。
zh_hk.lockedBody: 評價提交後 48 小時內可以修改。
zh_hk.signInBody: 請以這份已完成工作的顧客或工作者身分登入，然後留下評價。
zh_hk.ineligibleBody: 訂單完成後，顧客和已預約的工作者可以留下評價。
zh_hk.unavailable: 暫時未能載入評價。請稍後再試。
